did.description: The DID a **wallet** invitation is for: the invitee claims it by signing as this DID (vtc/install/claim/start and finish 0.3). Absent, the invitation is a **passkey** invitation, and the administrator's DID is derived from the passkey the invitee registers (vtc/install/claim/passkey/start and finish 0.1).

label.description: Operator-facing note, recorded as the label of the administrator entry the invitation writes.

Response.title: VTC Admin Invites Create — response payload

installUrl.description: One-shot enrolment URL. Returned once and never retrievable again.

claimCode.description: Secret that authorises the enrolment. Returned once.

aclEntryCreated.description: True when this call wrote an administrator entry: a wallet invitation for a DID that held none. Always false for a passkey invitation, whose entry is written when it is claimed.
